import sys

def main():
    import sys
    r, c = map(int, sys.stdin.read().strip().split())
    instructions = []
    
    # Move right to the end of the row
    instructions.append('R' * (c - 1))
    # Move down one row
    instructions.append('D')
    # Move left to the start of the row
    instructions.append('L' * (c - 1))
    # Move down to the second last row
    instructions.append('D' * (r - 2))
    # Move right to the end of the row
    instructions.append('RU' * (c - 1))
    # Move down to the last row
    instructions.append('D')
    # Move left to the start
    instructions.append('L' * (c - 1))
    
    print(''.join(instructions))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
